empty.title: There are no pages to show yet

load.description: Something went wrong while loading it. You can try again here.

edit.busyHint: Hang on until it finishes, then try again.
edit.pendingIndexDescription: Your text is saved. Reprocess the rulebook to sync the AI.
edit.savedDescription: The AI will use your version from now on.

image.errorDescription: Try again to view the original page.
image.errorTitle: The image could not be loaded
image.keyboardHint: Original image. Use arrow keys to pan, + and - to zoom, and 0 to fit the page.
image.missingDescription: You can still read the manual's text.

duplicate.label: Duplicate
duplicate.tip: This page is identical to another you already uploaded. It won't be read again because it doesn't add anything new, so this copy won't count toward the explanation.

edited.label: Edited by hand
edited.tip: You corrected this page by hand.

empty.label: No text available
empty.tip: This page has no text available to consult.

failed.label: Reading error
failed.tip: We couldn't extract text from this page. Try again or upload another photo.

low.label: Needs review
low.tip: The OCR isn't sure about this page. You can read it again or correct it by hand.

ok.label: Text available
ok.tip: Text available to consult. You can compare it with the original page.

text.editingHint: Correct the text, then save your changes.
text.empty: There isn't any readable text on this page.
